text: {"rules":[{"id":"BREASTFEEDING-SUPPORT-PREG-POSTPARTUM","version":"April 2025","title":"Breastfeeding support interventions or referrals during pregnancy and after birth","source_quote":"The USPSTF recommends providing interventions or referrals, during pregnancy and after birth, to support breastfeeding.","grade":"B","effective_date":"April 2025","action":"Provide interventions or referrals, during pregnancy and after birth, to support breastfeeding.","denominator":"{\"any\": [{\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"pregnancy\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"during pregnancy\", \"note\": \"Measurement-year scoping of pregnancy is a modeling choice; the text gives no timing.\"}, {\"condition\": {\"concept\": \"postpartum\", \"onset_by\": \"{MY}-12-31\"}, \"quote\": \"after birth\", \"note\": \"The text does not define the length of the postpartum period.\"}], \"quote\": \"pregnant and postpartum women\"}","numerator":"{\"procedure\": {\"concept\": \"breastfeeding_support_intervention\", \"window\": [\"{MY}-01-01\", \"{MY}-12-31\"]}, \"quote\": \"providing interventions or referrals, during pregnancy and after birth, to support breastfeeding\", \"note\": \"New concept (not in vocabulary): a breastfeeding support intervention or a referral for one. Structured EHR capture of such counseling or referrals may be unreliable, so this rule needs human review before deployment.","The text does not say what kind of intervention is meant (counseling, education, peer support, referral), how often or how many interventions to give, or how long the postpartum period lasts.
